label: Kimi K3.1 Pro (Kimi CLI)
explanation: Conservative rank-8 attention-output edit at layer 15. Behavioral tests found copied incorrect guesses in concise responses; full-attention diagnostics showed strong attention to proposed-answer tokens. On plain-versus-wrong activation patching, restoring layer 15 improved two fresh held-out cases (June restored to May; Ankara substantially recovered). The LoRA subtracts 0.4 of a deterministic 8-dimensional wrong-versus-plain/right input-difference subspace from the original attention output. The subspace is taken only from the original 16 facts, with fresh wrong/right/plain/confident-correct data reserved as diagnostics. Split validation showed positive restoration alignment for every split. Correct conditions had lower local displacement and high-confidence correct prompts lower still; layer 19 and MLP broad edits were rejected for indiscriminate answer-content effects. File verified for keys, shapes, rank, float32 finite values and reconstruction. Frobenius norm is 0.41670 (0.02080 of original weight norm). Per Track A, I did not generate with or otherwise evaluate the adapter; actual edited answer accuracy is not claimed.
